properties.displayName: UAV S34 - Operator Reconnaissance / Credential Brute Force
properties.description: UAV 운영자 계정 정찰 및 자격증명 브루트포스 탐지. [A] 단일 IP 1분 내 로그인 실패 5회 이상(브루트포스) [B] 단일 IP 5분 내 서로 다른 Operator 4개 이상 시도(계정 목록 정찰/스캐닝) [C] Approved_Operators_List 미포함 Operator의 로그인 성공(비인가 접근). UAVOpAudit_CL 기반. MITRE: T1078, T1595
properties.query:
let approvedOps = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Operators_List') | project OperatorId;
let lookback = 1h;
// [블록 A] 브루트포스 - 1분 내 동일 IP 5회 이상 실패
let BruteForce =
    UAVOpAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where EventType == "login_failure"
    | summarize FailCount = count(), Operators = make_set(Operator)
        by ClientIp, bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
    | where FailCount >= 5
    | extend TriggerReason = "정찰_브루트포스_단일IP_다중실패"
    | extend DetectionDetail = strcat(
        "ClientIp:", ClientIp,
        "|FailCount:", FailCount,
        "|Operators:", tostring(Operators)
    )
    | extend UAVId = "SOC-AUTH"
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, TriggerReason, DetectionDetail, ClientIp;
// [블록 B] 계정 목록 정찰 - 5분 내 동일 IP에서 서로 다른 Operator 4개 이상 시도
let Recon =
    UAVOpAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where EventType == "login_failure"
    | summarize DistinctOperators = dcount(Operator), TriedOperators = make_set(Operator)
        by ClientIp, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
    | where DistinctOperators >= 4
    | extend TriggerReason = "정찰_계정목록_스캐닝_다중Operator시도"
    | extend DetectionDetail = strcat(
        "ClientIp:", ClientIp,
        "|DistinctOperators:", DistinctOperators,
        "|Tried:", tostring(TriedOperators)
    )
    | extend UAVId = "SOC-AUTH"
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, TriggerReason, DetectionDetail, ClientIp;
// [블록 C] 비인가 Operator 로그인 성공
let UnauthorizedOperator =
    UAVOpAudit_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
    | where EventType == "login_success"
    | where Operator !in (approvedOps)
    | extend TriggerReason = "비인가_Operator_로그인성공"
    | extend DetectionDetail = strcat("Operator:", Operator, "|ClientIp:", ClientIp)
    | extend UAVId = "SOC-AUTH"
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, TriggerReason, DetectionDetail, ClientIp;
BruteForce
| union Recon
| union UnauthorizedOperator
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S34 - Operator Reconnaissance / Credential Brute Force [{{TriggerReason}}]
